rationale: With only 3 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced market liquidation, creating unacceptable slippage risk especially given WNC's elevated volatility today (down ~10% from open, near session lows). The stock is trading at 2.3% of its daily range with no clear reversal signal, and the broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.26%, VIXY +7.72%), making a directional edge within this timeframe negligible. The risk/reward does not justify entry at this stage of the session.
